profile_text.body:
Google is a public company founded in 1998 and headquartered in Mountain View, CA, whose website at the time of collection was focused on Gemini, which it describes as its AI assistant designed to help with writing, planning, brainstorming, and related tasks.

The company's tracked AI products span several categories. Gemini is its general-purpose large language model assistant, and Google AI Studio serves as a model prototyping environment for developers. NotebookLM is a document-grounded research tool that ingests uploaded corpora. Google Med-PaLM and MedLM are medical large language models oriented toward clinical reasoning and healthcare data, with a HIPAA BAA required. Additional products include Google Drive AI and Google Meet AI, both integrated with Google Workspace, and TensorFlow and Keras, open-source machine learning frameworks that also support MLOps workflows through TensorFlow Extended.

Google is a publicly traded company with the ticker GOOGL and an SEC CIK of 0001652044. Its most recently recorded annual revenue, reported on a 10-K for the period ending 2025-12-31, was $402,836,000,000. No litigation is recorded in the held facts. Several third-party MCP servers exist for Google services including Google Ads, Google Calendar, Google Forms, Google News, Google Search Console, and Google Trends, built by various external developers rather than by Google directly.
